description: Repair or regenerate a local image region using a mask and prompt.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the base image. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height, and its width-to-height ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Prompt describing how to redraw the masked area.
fields.example: remove scratches and keep the product realistic

fields.name: maskUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the mask image.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.

example.prompt: remove scratches and keep the product realistic
